races.verdict: RADIATOR SPRINGS again shaped like a very well-treated mare when fourth of 18 at Listowel on her return last month and gets the nod to confirm the promise of that run faced with a seemingly ideal test. The selection's stablemate Lieber Nicc hasn't been seen since winning this race last year, but that is no bad thing given he's plainly very capable fresh and must be taken seriously in his bid to repeat the feat from a 10 lb higher mark. Ben Hur remains unexposed and completes the shortlist. RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE) LIEBER NICC (IRE) BEN HUR (IRE)

races.verdict: JET TO VEGAS has been lightly raced in recent seasons and bounced right back to his best following 4 months off when defeating a next-time-out winner at Market Rasen 5 weeks ago. His very best form over fences has come in small fields and he could well be worthy of siding with to follow up. Dance And Glance and Glynn Brae are 2 interesting chase debutants, though, whilst The Gray Ghost appeals as the type to come forward from his Uttoxeter chase debut second. races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: A useful handicap which seems sure to make for strong form. PRINCLING shaped encouragingly back down in trip after 3 months off (gelded since in interim) when third in a minor event at Ascot last time and looks on a good mark now returning to handicap company. Fellow 3-y-o Portcullis won both his starts back in the spring and remains open to significant improvement, while there could easily be more to come from Murashah , who's 2 from 2 for Ed Bethell. PRINCLING PORTCULLIS MURASHAH (IRE)

races.display_title: Dusseldorf's Henkel 169 German Oaks Handicap
races.verdict: A useful handicap. BEAGLE BAY let favourite backers down at York earlier in the month but is probably worth another chance given how well his Sandown defeat of Raammee in June has worked out. Returning Gosden stable handicap newcomer Lighting Thunder brings obvious unexposed potential. Charlie Appleby pair Man of Vision and Fort Rock are also 3-y-os with positive profiles, while River King scored in good style at Doncaster last weekend. BEAGLE BAY (FR) LIGHTING THUNDER MAN OF VISION
